how_it_is_used: Every excuse is applied to BOTH sides before comparison, so an excuse can only remove a difference, never create one.
A difference that disappears after the excuses are applied is reported as explained, with the D-items that removed it. Anything left is unexplained and fails.
kind 'replace': text replaced wherever it occurs. kind 'remove': text removed wherever it occurs. kind 'remove-line': whole lines matching the regex removed from multi-line text.
kind 'key': the named observation keys (glob, * = any run of characters) are excused outright. kind 'value': on matching keys, the listed value is mapped to another.
kind 'selector': elements excused from the visual-structure checks. kind 'network': requests to the host are excused from the network check.

kind 'placeholder': the selector or text cannot be known until the rebuild exists. With a real candidate (not the reference itself), every placeholder must be filled in AND match something in the candidate, or the D-map check fails loudly.
kind 'require': with a real candidate, the candidate must show the planned difference (text present or absent). Skipped in self-parity.
